title: Identity-Locked Transformation Sequence
description: A nine-image identity-locked portrait sequence for Artist Press Portrait Suite: one reference frame followed by eight dependent variations that preserve the same subject while changing lighting, scene, styling, or mood.
creative_direction: Image 01 is the required identity reference for Artist Press Portrait Suite. Images 02-09 must all depend on that reference and preserve the same face, hair base, skin-tone family, and body proportions while exploring the media-use, styling, and mood range suggested by the backlog brief.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-identity-sheet first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-press-hero-portrait, 03-interview-three-quarter, 04-monochrome-close-crop, 05-cover-crop-portrait, 06-prop-supported-editorial, 07-lighting-mood-shift, 08-off-duty-candid-portrait, 09-campaign-finale-portrait. Queue may run 02-09 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.

en.title: Identity-Locked Transformation Sequence
en.description: A nine-image identity-locked portrait sequence for Artist Press Portrait Suite that turns one stable subject into a usable publicity, editorial, or transformation system.
